title: schedonorus divaricatus
intro: Schedonorus divaricatus, commonly known as timothy grass, is a type of perennial grass native to Europe and Asia. It is valued for its health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of allergies and asthma. The therapeutic actions of timothy grass include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its ability to soothe respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of timothy grass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and fatty acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
